reconcile.note: Gill limits the promise that all flesh shall see YHWH's glory to spiritual perception offered in the gospel, not literal sight guaranteed to the unconverted wicked.

sides.snippet: will not see the majesty of Yahweh.
sides.verseText: Let favor be shown to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness; in the land of uprightness will he deal wrongfully, and will not see the majesty of Yahweh.

sides.snippet: all flesh shall see it together
sides.verseText: and the glory of Yahweh shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together; for the mouth of Yahweh has spoken it.
